audits.observations: Root ordered second reading: whole image and both actual supplied halves viewed before the image-first receipt and text opening; all45 fresh audit crops personally viewed, including upright slanted additions. Every agreed/differing word, accent, index, sign, cancellation, insertion, underline and marginal mark was compared with the ink. The unmarked final F is retained; the first F overmark remains a tilde. Six physical word divisions, a comma before the inserted operation sentence, explicit abbreviation overprinting, the blue enclosure gap and the corollary underline endpoint are corrected. The added sentence has its own underline and doubtful terminal punctuation. Both low circular bottom indices now carry the same o|0 doubt. The partly clipped and deeply cancelled text remains doubtful; no uncovered ink warrants filling the obscured words with certainty. Sur le, volume39|34, the fidèlement overprint, toute ouvert, base,S, noéthérien accents and E tensor_U U-prime remain as written. Two nonlexical marks above the heading are drawn without interpreting their origin. Manuscript16 and archive47 remain distinct. Fourteen doubts remain. No context or mathematical proof check was used.
